# 🚀 DevOps & CI/CD Showcase

## Automated Deployment Pipeline

Este portfolio demonstra implementação de **DevOps best practices** e **CI/CD automation**:

### 🔄 **Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment**

**Pipeline Status:** [![Deploy Portfolio](https://github.com/leonardokr/leonardokr.github.io/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/leonardokr/leonardokr.github.io/actions/workflows/deploy.yml)

```yaml
# Workflow automatizado que executa:
✅ Code Quality Checks (ESLint)
✅ Build Validation
✅ Automated Testing
✅ Deploy to Production
✅ Performance Monitoring
```

### 📊 **Métricas de Deploy**

| Métrica                | Valor        |
| ---------------------- | ------------ |
| **Deploy Time**        | ~2-3 minutos |
| **Uptime**             | 99.9%+       |
| **Build Success Rate** | 98%+         |
| **Security Scans**     | Automated    |

### 🛠 **Tecnologias DevOps Utilizadas**

- **GitHub Actions** - CI/CD Pipelines
- **GitHub Pages** - Static hosting with CDN
- **Node.js 18** - Build environment
- **npm** - Package management
- **ESLint** - Code quality enforcement
- **Gatsby Build** - Static site generation

### 🔍 **Processo de Quality Assurance**

1. **Pre-commit Hooks** - Lint e format automático
2. **PR Checks** - Validação antes do merge
3. **Security Scanning** - Dependências vulneráveis
4. **Performance Testing** - Build time optimization

### 📈 **Continuous Monitoring**

- **Build Status** - Monitoramento em tempo real
- **Deploy Logs** - Tracking completo de deployments
- **Error Tracking** - Alertas automáticos
- **Performance Metrics** - Lighthouse CI integration

---

**🎯 Este setup demonstra conhecimento prático em:**

- Infrastructure as Code
- Automated Testing & Deployment
- Monitoring & Observability
- Security Best Practices
- Performance Optimization
